# Load packages

```{r, message = F}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
```

# Load datasets

## Load institution-level datasets from years 2005-2025

First, read in every dataset from raw data files

```{r}
# loop over every dataset to read it in and save to a different variable
for(i in 5:25) {
  if (i == 5) { # 2004-2005 had one excel file with docs + data
    var_name = "instLevel_05"
    path = "../raw_data/EADA_2004-2005/EADA 2004-2005 Institution--inst file.xls"
    ds = read_excel(path, sheet = "instleveldata")
    
  } else if (i < 10) { # years before 2010 get a preceding 0
    var_name = paste0("instLevel_0", i)
    path = paste0("../raw_data/EADA_200", as.character(i-1), "-200", as.character(i), "/Instleveldata.xls")
    ds = read_excel(path) %>%
      mutate(zip_text = as.character(zip_text))
    
  } else if (i == 10) { # 2010 combines preceding 0 and no 0 in filename
    var_name = "instLevel_10"
    path = "../raw_data/EADA_2009-2010/Instleveldata.xls"
    ds = read_excel(path) %>%
      mutate(zip_text = as.character(zip_text))
    
  } else if (i < 13) { # until 2013, new filename and old version of excel
    var_name = paste0("instLevel_", i)
    path = paste0("../raw_data/EADA_20", as.character(i-1), "-20", as.character(i), "/Instlevel.xls")
    ds = read_excel(path)
    
  } else { # after 2013 saved with new version of excel
    var_name = paste0("instLevel_", i)
    path = paste0("../raw_data/EADA_20", as.character(i-1), "-20", as.character(i), "/instLevel.xlsx")
    ds = read_excel(path)
  }
  
  ds$year = i # add year column to ds to distinguish when combining
  assign(var_name, ds) # save ds to its variable name
}
```

Next, convert every ds to the same format. Years 2004-2005 and 2005-2006 especially need it

```{r}
# key to map the old year var names to the newer practice
key = read_csv("../raw_data/var names map - instLevel.csv")

# 2005 map
map_05 = key %>%
  filter(!is.na(new_name) & !(new_name %in% c("", "OPEID", "sector_cd", "sector_name", "RECRUITEXP_COED"))) %>%
  select(name_05, new_name)

# 2006 map
map_06 = key %>%
  filter(!is.na(new_name) & !(new_name %in% c("", "OPEID", "sector_cd", "sector_name"))) %>%
  select(name_06, new_name)

# create map of uppercase recent inst names to be used to convert 2005 ds
name_map = instLevel_25 %>%
  rename("new_name" = institution_name) %>%
  select(new_name) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(match_key = toupper(new_name))

# create map of sector names and codes to add columns to 2005 and 2006 ds
sector_lookup = instLevel_25 %>%
  select(unitid, sector_cd, sector_name) %>%
  distinct(unitid, .keep_all = TRUE)

# create map of opeid to add column to 2005 and 2006 ds
opeid_lookup = instLevel_25 %>%
  select(unitid, OPEID) %>%
  distinct(unitid, .keep_all = TRUE)


# clean 2005 ds and convert to same format as recent years
instLevel_05 = instLevel_05 %>% 
  select(-enrollment_description) %>% # enroll desc column only in 2005
  rename_with( # convert column names to recent year format
    ~ deframe(map_05)[.x], 
    .cols = intersect(names(instLevel_05), map_05$name_05)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # names that aren't mapped to 2025 will not remain all uppercase
    institution_name = str_to_title(institution_name),
    match_key = toupper(institution_name), # make sure all upper for match
    RECRUITEXP_COED = NA_real_ # add column that appears in all other ds
  ) %>%
  left_join(name_map, by = "match_key") %>% # match inst names with 2025 to convert case
  mutate(
    name = coalesce(new_name, institution_name), # keep old name if not matched
    across( # convert column types to numeric to match other ds
      all_of(c("STUDENTAID_COED", "HDCOACH_SALARY_COED", "NUM_HDCOACH_COED")),
      as.numeric
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-match_key, -new_name, -institution_name) %>% # remove matching cols
  rename("institution_name" = name) %>%
  left_join(sector_lookup, by = "unitid") %>% # add sector_cd and sector_name cols
  left_join(opeid_lookup, by = "unitid") %>% # add OPEID col
  select(names(instLevel_25)) # reorder cols

# clean 2006 ds and convert to same format as recent years
instLevel_06 = instLevel_06 %>% 
  rename_with( # convert column names to recent year format
    ~ deframe(map_06)[.x], 
    .cols = intersect(names(instLevel_06), map_06$name_06)
  ) %>%
  left_join(sector_lookup, by = "unitid") %>% # add sector_cd and sector_name cols
  left_join(opeid_lookup, by = "unitid") %>% # add OPEID col
  select(names(instLevel_25)) # reorder cols
```

Finally, combine all years into one ds

```{r}
# combine years into one ds
instLevel_all = bind_rows(
  instLevel_05,
  instLevel_06,
  instLevel_07,
  instLevel_08,
  instLevel_09,
  instLevel_10,
  instLevel_11,
  instLevel_12,
  instLevel_13,
  instLevel_14,
  instLevel_15,
  instLevel_16,
  instLevel_17,
  instLevel_18,
  instLevel_19,
  instLevel_20,
  instLevel_21,
  instLevel_22,
  instLevel_23,
  instLevel_24,
  instLevel_25
) %>%
  mutate( # store whole year not just last 2 digits
    year = year + 2000
  ) %>%
  arrange(year, institution_name)
  
instLevel_all
```

## Add adjusted money columns

Based on HEPI index, adjust money data so it can be compared across years

```{r}
hepi = read_excel("../raw_data/hepi.xlsx", col_names = T, skip = 1)

# add manual values for 2023-2025
add_hepi = tibble(
  year = c("2023", "2024", "2025"),
  hepi = c(396.2, 409.7, 424.6)
)

# rename value column, grab year from school year, remove na, add manual data
hepi = hepi %>%
  rename("hepi" = `Higher Education Price Index\\2\\`) %>%
  mutate(
    year = case_when(
      str_starts(`School year`, "19") ~ paste0("19", substr(`School year`, 6, 7)),
      str_starts(`School year`, "20") ~ paste0("20", substr(`School year`, 6, 7))
    ),
    hepi = na_if(hepi, "---"),
    hepi = as.numeric(hepi)
  ) %>%
  select(year, hepi) %>%
  na.omit() %>%
  bind_rows(add_hepi)

# make sure year column in numeric
hepi$year = as.numeric(hepi$year)

# target base year (converting everything to 2025 dollars)
target_year = 2025
base_hepi = hepi$hepi[hepi$year == target_year]

# add to instLevel data
adjusted_instLevel = instLevel_all %>%
  left_join(hepi, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(
    # Formula: Nominal * (Base CPI / Year CPI)
    real_grnd_expense = GRND_TOTAL_EXPENSE * (base_hepi / hepi),
    real_opexp = IL_TOTAL_OPEXP_INCLCOED * (base_hepi / hepi),
    real_opexp_athlete = ((IL_SUM_OPEXPPERPART_WOMEN + IL_SUM_OPEXPPERPART_MEN)/2) * (base_hepi / hepi),
    real_recruit_exp = RECRUITEXP_TOTAL * (base_hepi / hepi) # might not include coed recruiting...
    # can add salary adjustments if needed
  )

adjusted_instLevel
```



## Load sport-level datasets from years 2005-2025

First, read in every dataset from raw data files

```{r}
# loop over every dataset to read it in and save to a different variable
# guess_max used b/c there was an issue with NAs and guessing the wrong col type
for(i in 5:25) {
  if (i == 5) { # 2004-2005 had one excel file with docs + data
    var_name = "schools_05"
    path = "../raw_data/EADA_2004-2005/EADA 2004-2005 institution--multiple records rev and exp.xls"
    ds = read_excel(path, sheet = "schools", guess_max = 16000)
    
  } else if (i < 10) { # years before 2010 get a preceding 0
    var_name = paste0("schools_0", i)
    path = paste0("../raw_data/EADA_200", as.character(i-1), "-200", as.character(i), "/Schools.xls")
    ds = read_excel(path, guess_max = 16000) %>%
      mutate(zip_text = as.character(zip_text))
    
  } else if (i == 10) { # 2010 combines a preceding 0 and no 0 in filename
    var_name = "schools_10"
    path = "../raw_data/EADA_2009-2010/Schools.xls"
    ds = read_excel(path, guess_max = 16000) %>%
      mutate(zip_text = as.character(zip_text))
    
  } else if (i < 13) { # before 2013 uses old excel file type
    var_name = paste0("schools_", i)
    path = paste0("../raw_data/EADA_20", as.character(i-1), "-20", as.character(i), "/Schools.xls")
    ds = read_excel(path, guess_max = 16000)
    
  } else if (i < 24) { # until 2024 uses uppercase S in filename
    var_name = paste0("schools_", i)
    path = paste0("../raw_data/EADA_20", as.character(i-1), "-20", as.character(i), "/Schools.xlsx")
    ds = read_excel(path, guess_max = 16000)
    
  } else { # 2025 uses lowercase s in filename
    var_name = paste0("schools_", i)
    path = paste0("../raw_data/EADA_20", as.character(i-1), "-20", as.character(i), "/schools.xlsx")
    ds = read_excel(path, guess_max = 16000)
  }
  
  ds$year = i # add year column to ds to distinguish when combining
  assign(var_name, ds) # save ds to its variable name
}
```

Next, convert every ds to the same format. Years 2005, 2006, 2019 especially need it

```{r}
# key to map the old year var names to the newer practice
key = read_csv("../raw_data/var names map - schools.csv")

# 2005 map
map_05 = key %>%
  filter(!is.na(new_name) & !(new_name %in% c("", "OPEID", "sector_cd", "sector_name"))) %>%
  select(name_05, new_name)

# 2006 map
map_06 = key %>%
  filter(!is.na(new_name) & !(new_name %in% c("", "OPEID", "sector_cd", "sector_name"))) %>%
  select(name_06, new_name)

# create map of uppercase recent inst names to be used to convert 2005 ds
name_map = schools_25 %>%
  rename("new_name" = institution_name) %>%
  select(new_name) %>%
  distinct() %>%
  mutate(match_key = toupper(new_name))

# create map of sector names and codes to add cols to 2005 and 2006 ds
sector_lookup = schools_25 %>%
  select(unitid, sector_cd, sector_name) %>%
  distinct(unitid, .keep_all = TRUE)

# create map of opeid to add col to 2005 and 2006 ds
opeid_lookup = schools_25 %>%
  select(unitid, OPEID) %>%
  distinct(unitid, .keep_all = TRUE) 


# clean 2005 and convert to same format as recent years
schools_05 = schools_05 %>% 
  select(-enrollment_description) %>% # enroll desc not used in other ds
  rename_with( # convert col names to recent format
    ~ deframe(map_05)[.x], 
    .cols = intersect(names(schools_05), map_05$name_05)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    # names that aren't mapped to 2025 will not remain all uppercase
    institution_name = str_to_title(institution_name),
    match_key = toupper(institution_name) # make sure all upper for match
  ) %>%
  # match inst names with 2025 to convert case
  left_join(name_map, by = "match_key") %>%
  mutate(
    name = coalesce(new_name, institution_name), # keep old name if not matched
    across( # coed vars read in as char for some reason, convert to num
      all_of(c(
        "TOTAL_EXP_COED", "EXP_COED_WOMEN", "EXP_COED_MEN",
        "TOTAL_REV_COED", "REV_COED_WOMEN", "REV_COED_MEN",
        "COED_PTACUNIVEMP_FEM", "COED_FTACUNIVEMP_FEM",
        "COED_PTASTCOACH_FEM", "COED_FTASTCOACH_FEM",
        "COED_PTACUNEMP_MALE", "COED_FTACUNEMP_MALE",
        "COED_PTASCOACH_MALE", "COED_FTASCOACH_MALE",
        "COED_TOTAL_ASTCOACH", "COED_TOTAL_HDCOACH",
        "COED_PTUNIVEMP_FEM", "COED_FTUNIVEMP_FEM",
        "COED_PTHDCOACH_FEM", "COED_FTHDCOACH_FEM",
        "COED_PTUNIVEMP_MALE", "COED_FTUNIVEMP_MALE",
        "COED_PTHDCOACH_MALE", "COED_FTHDCOACH_MALE",
        "TOTAL_OPEXP_COEDTEAM", "OPEXPPERTEAM_COED_MEN",
        "PARTIC_COED_MEN")
      ),
      as.numeric
    )
  ) %>%
  select(-match_key, -new_name, -institution_name) %>% # remove matching cols
  rename("institution_name" = name) %>%
  left_join(sector_lookup, by = "unitid") %>% # add sector_cd and sector_name cols
  left_join(opeid_lookup, by = "unitid") %>% # add OPEID col
  select(names(schools_25)) # reorder cols


# clean 2006 and convert to same format as recent years
schools_06 = schools_06 %>% 
  rename_with( # convert col names to recent format
    ~ deframe(map_06)[.x], 
    .cols = intersect(names(schools_06), map_06$name_06)
  ) %>%
  left_join(sector_lookup, by = "unitid") %>% # add sector_cd and sector_name cols
  left_join(opeid_lookup, by = "unitid") %>% # add OPEID col
  select(names(schools_25)) # reorder cols


# vars in 2019 ds that were read in as char, need to convert to num
char_names = c(
  names(schools_19[16:127]),
  "sector_cd", 
  "EFTotalCount", 
  "EFFemaleCount", 
  "EFMaleCount", 
  "ClassificationCode", 
  "unitid"
)

# convert char cols that should be num
schools_19 = schools_19 %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(char_names), as.numeric))
```

# Create sports_ds from schools_all
sports_ds contains one observation for one sport at one school, with coed exception which is split into 2 to track men and women participation.

```{r}
# make one row for each gender for each sport
gender_long = schools_all %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      PARTIC_MEN,
      PARTIC_WOMEN,
      PARTIC_COED_MEN,
      PARTIC_COED_WOMEN
    ),
    names_to = "athlete_gender",
    values_to = "n_athletes"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    team_type = recode_values( # preserve whether men, women, or coed
      athlete_gender,
      "PARTIC_MEN" ~ "Men",
      "PARTIC_WOMEN" ~ "Women",
      "PARTIC_COED_MEN" ~ "Coed",
      "PARTIC_COED_WOMEN" ~ "Coed"
    ),
    athlete_gender = recode_values( # determine sport gender of row (coed split)
      athlete_gender,
      "PARTIC_MEN" ~ "Men",
      "PARTIC_COED_MEN" ~ "Men",
      "PARTIC_WOMEN" ~ "Women",
      "PARTIC_COED_WOMEN" ~ "Women"
    ),
    Sports = recode_values( # add preceding gender type to sport label (for coed id)
      team_type,
      "Men" ~ paste("Men's", Sports),
      "Women" ~ paste("Women's", Sports),
      "Coed" ~ paste("Coed", Sports)
    )
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(n_athletes)) %>% # remove rows where there was no participation
  mutate(
    op_exp_per_athlete = recode_values( # operating expense per athlete metric
      team_type,
      "Men" ~ OPEXPPERPART_MEN,
      "Women" ~ OPEXPPERPART_WOMEN,
      "Coed" ~ OPEXPPERPART_COED_MEN
    ),
    op_exp = recode_values( # operating expense per team metric
      team_type,
      "Men" ~ OPEXPPERTEAM_MEN,
      "Women" ~ OPEXPPERTEAM_WOMEN,
      "Coed" ~ OPEXPPERTEAM_COED_MEN
    ),
    revenue = recode_values( # revenue per team metric
      team_type,
      "Men" ~ REV_MEN,
      "Women" ~ REV_WOMEN,
      "Coed" ~ REV_COED_MEN
    ),
    expense = recode_values( # expense per team metric
      team_type,
      "Men" ~ EXP_MEN,
      "Women" ~ EXP_WOMEN,
      "Coed" ~ EXP_COED_MEN
    )
  )


# clean coaches data and select relevant vars
sports_ds = gender_long %>%
  mutate(
    total_hc = case_when( # get total number of head coaches for team
      grepl("^Men's", Sports) ~ MEN_TOTAL_HEADCOACH,
      grepl("^Women's", Sports) ~ WOMEN_TOTAL_HDCOACH,
      grepl("^Coed", Sports) ~ COED_TOTAL_HDCOACH
    ),
    total_ac = case_when( # get total number of assistant coaches for team
      grepl("^Men's", Sports) ~ MEN_TOTAL_ASSTCOACH,
      grepl("^Women's", Sports) ~ WOMEN_TOTAL_ASTCOACH,
      grepl("^Coed", Sports) ~ COED_TOTAL_ASTCOACH
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate( # replace na with 0; na means there was not a coach but maybe still team
    total_hc = replace_na(total_hc, 0),
    total_ac = replace_na(total_ac, 0)
  ) %>%
  select( # remove old/unnecessary cols
    year,
    unitid,
    institution_name,
    sport = Sports,
    athlete_gender,
    n_athletes,
    op_exp,
    op_exp_per_athlete,
    expense,
    revenue,
    total_hc,
    total_ac
  ) %>%
  arrange(year, institution_name, sport, athlete_gender)

sports_ds
```

## Add adjusted money columns

Based on HEPI index, adjust money data so it can be compared across years

```{r}
# join and calculate real/adjusted values
adjusted_sports = sports_ds %>%
  left_join(hepi, by = "year") %>%
  mutate(
    # Formula: Nominal * (Base CPI / Year CPI)
    real_expense = expense * (base_hepi / hepi),
    real_opexp = op_exp * (base_hepi / hepi),
    real_opexp_athlete = op_exp_per_athlete * (base_hepi / hepi)
  )

adjusted_sports

# save data to clean folder
write_csv(adjusted_sports, "../clean_data/sports_ds.csv")
```


## Add nsports column to instLevel data
```{r}
# summarize number of sports for each school and year from sport-level data
nsport_ds = adjusted_sports %>%
  group_by(year, institution_name) %>%
  summarize(
    nsports = n_distinct(sport)
  )

# join with instLevel data from above
final_instLevel = adjusted_instLevel %>%
  left_join(
    nsport_ds,
    by = c("year", "institution_name")
  )

final_instLevel


# save data to clean folder
write_csv(final_instLevel, "../clean_data/instLevel_ds.csv")


```




# Create coach_ds
coach_ds contains one observation for one coach for one sport at one school. Coaches can be full or part-time coaches and full or part-time employees at the school.

```{r}
# preserve the totals for validation
coach_totals = schools_all %>%
  select(
    year, unitid, institution_name, Sports, MEN_TOTAL_HEADCOACH, WOMEN_TOTAL_HDCOACH, COED_TOTAL_HDCOACH, MEN_TOTAL_ASSTCOACH, WOMEN_TOTAL_ASTCOACH, COED_TOTAL_ASTCOACH, SUM_FTHDCOACH_MALE, SUM_PTHDCOACH_MALE, SUM_FTUNIVEMP_MALE, SUM_PTUNIVEMP_MALE, SUM_FTHDCOACH_FEM, SUM_PTHDCOACH_FEM, SUM_FTUNIVEMP_FEM, SUM_PTUNIVEMP_FEM, SUM_FTASCOACH_MALE, SUM_PTASCOACH_MALE, SUM_FTACUNIVEMP_MALE, SUM_PTACUNIVEMP_MALE, SUM_FTASCOACH_FEM, SUM_PTASCOACH_FEM, SUM_FTACUNIVEMP_FEM, SUM_PTACUNIVEMP_FEM, SUM_TOTAL_ASSTCOACH, SUM_TOTAL_HDCOACH
  )


# map the source variables to their meanings (lot of different spellings)
coach_map = tribble( 
  ~athlete_gender, ~coach_role, ~coach_gender, ~team_assignment, ~assignment_var, ~employment_var,

  "Men", "Head", "Male", "Full-time", "MEN_FTHEADCOACH_MALE", "MEN_FTUNIVEMPLOY_MALE",
  "Men", "Head", "Male", "Part-time", "MEN_PTHEADCOACH_MALE", "MEN_PTUNIVEMPLOY_MALE",
  "Men", "Head", "Female", "Full-time", "MEN_FTHEADCOACH_FEM", "MEN_FTUNIVEMPLOY_FEM",
  "Men", "Head", "Female", "Part-time", "MEN_PTHEADCOACH_FEM", "MEN_PTUNIVEMPLOY_FEM",

  "Women", "Head", "Male", "Full-time", "WOMEN_FTHDCOACH_MALE", "WOMEN_FTUNIVEMP_MALE",
  "Women", "Head", "Male", "Part-time", "WOMEN_PTHDCOACH_MALE", "WOMEN_PTUNIVEMP_MALE",
  "Women", "Head", "Female", "Full-time", "WOMEN_FTHDCOACH_FEM", "WOMEN_FTUNIVEMP_FEM",
  "Women", "Head", "Female", "Part-time", "WOMEN_PTHDCOACH_FEM", "WOMEN_PTUNIVEMP_FEM",

  "Coed", "Head", "Male", "Full-time", "COED_FTHDCOACH_MALE", "COED_FTUNIVEMP_MALE",
  "Coed", "Head", "Male", "Part-time", "COED_PTHDCOACH_MALE", "COED_PTUNIVEMP_MALE",
  "Coed", "Head", "Female", "Full-time", "COED_FTHDCOACH_FEM", "COED_FTUNIVEMP_FEM",
  "Coed", "Head", "Female", "Part-time", "COED_PTHDCOACH_FEM", "COED_PTUNIVEMP_FEM",

  "Men", "Assistant", "Male", "Full-time", "MEN_FTASCOACH_MALE", "MEN_FTACUNIVEMP_MALE",
  "Men", "Assistant", "Male", "Part-time", "MEN_PTASCOACH_MALE", "MEN_PTACUNIVEMP_MALE",
  "Men", "Assistant", "Female", "Full-time", "MEN_FTASSTCOACH_FEM", "MEN_FTACUNIVEMP_FEM",
  "Men", "Assistant", "Female", "Part-time", "MEN_PTASSTCOACH_FEM", "MEN_PTACUNIVEMP_FEM",

  "Women", "Assistant", "Male", "Full-time", "WOMEN_FTASCOACH_MALE", "WOMEN_FTACUNEMP_MALE",
  "Women", "Assistant", "Male", "Part-time", "WOMEN_PTASCOACH_MALE", "WOMEN_PTACUNEMP_MALE",
  "Women", "Assistant", "Female", "Full-time", "WOMEN_FTASTCOACH_FEM", "WOMN_FTACUNIVEMP_FEM",
  "Women", "Assistant", "Female", "Part-time", "WOMEN_PTASTCOACH_FEM", "WOMN_PTACUNIVEMP_FEM",

  "Coed", "Assistant", "Male", "Full-time", "COED_FTASCOACH_MALE", "COED_FTACUNEMP_MALE",
  "Coed", "Assistant", "Male", "Part-time", "COED_PTASCOACH_MALE", "COED_PTACUNEMP_MALE",
  "Coed", "Assistant", "Female", "Full-time", "COED_FTASTCOACH_FEM", "COED_FTACUNIVEMP_FEM",
  "Coed", "Assistant", "Female", "Part-time", "COED_PTASTCOACH_FEM", "COED_PTACUNIVEMP_FEM"
)


# expand team-assignment counts into one row per coach
coach_assignments = schools_all %>%
  select(
    year, unitid, institution_name, Sports,
    all_of(coach_map$assignment_var)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer( # make by coach instead of by sport
    cols = -c(year, unitid, institution_name, Sports),
    names_to = "source_variable",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  left_join( # map descriptive vars onto each row
    coach_map,
    by = c("source_variable" = "assignment_var")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(count), count > 0) %>% # only need rows where a coach exists
  uncount(weights = count, .id = "coach_number") # number of coaches in that 'group'


# expand university employment counts into a separate roster
coach_employment = schools_all %>%
  select(
    year, unitid, institution_name, Sports,
    all_of(coach_map$employment_var)
  ) %>%
  pivot_longer( # make by coach instead of by sport
    cols = -c(year, unitid, institution_name, Sports),
    names_to = "source_variable",
    values_to = "count"
  ) %>%
  left_join( # map descriptive vars onto each row
    coach_map,
    by = c("source_variable" = "employment_var")
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(count), count > 0) %>% # only need rows where a coach exists
  uncount(weights = count, .id = "employment_number") %>% # n coaches in that 'group'
  group_by(
    year, unitid, institution_name, Sports,
    athlete_gender, coach_role, coach_gender
  ) %>%
  mutate(coach_number = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  select( # only keep relevant vars
    year, unitid, institution_name, Sports,
    athlete_gender, coach_role, coach_gender,
    coach_number, university_employment = team_assignment
  )


# match the rosters and retain the totals
coach_ds = coach_assignments %>%
  group_by(
    year, unitid, institution_name, Sports,
    athlete_gender, coach_role, coach_gender
  ) %>%
  mutate(coach_number = row_number()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join( # join assignment and employment data into same ds
    coach_employment,
    by = c(
      "year", "unitid", "institution_name", "Sports",
      "athlete_gender", "coach_role", "coach_gender",
      "coach_number"
    )
  ) %>%
  select( # only keep relevant vars
    year, unitid, institution_name, sport = Sports,
    athlete_gender, coach_role, coach_gender,
    team_assignment, university_employment,
    coach_number
  ) %>%
  arrange(year, institution_name, sport, athlete_gender) 

coach_ds

# save data to clean folder
write_csv(coach_ds, "../clean_data/coach_ds.csv")
```

# Create NWC datasets

## Add whole institution total expense data

Use Propublica's API to get total expense data for NWC schools

```{r}
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)

# specify nwc schools
nwc_schools = c(
  "George Fox University",
  "Lewis & Clark College",
  "Linfield University",
  "Pacific Lutheran University",
  "Pacific University",
  "University of Puget Sound",
  "Whitman College",
  "Whitworth University",
  "Willamette University"
)

# attach eins with each nwc school
school_eins = tibble(
  school = nwc_schools,
  ein = c("930386839", "930386858", "930391586", "910565571", "930386892", "910564961", "910567740", "910473310", "930386972")
)

# function to get that school's total expense data from propublica
get_school_expenses = function(school, ein) {

  url = paste0(
    "https://projects.propublica.org/nonprofits/api/v2/organizations/",
    ein,
    ".json"
  )

  response = GET(url)
  stop_for_status(response)

  data = fromJSON(
    content(response, as = "text", encoding = "UTF-8")
  )

  filings = data$filings_with_data

  if (is.null(filings) || nrow(filings) == 0) {
    return(tibble(
      school = school,
      tax_prd = integer(),
      tax_prd_yr = integer(),
      formtype = integer(),
      total_expenses = numeric()
    ))
  }

  filings %>%
    transmute(
      school = school,
      tax_prd,
      tax_prd_yr,
      formtype,
      total_expenses = totfuncexpns
    )
}


# create ds with each nwc school's expenses
nwc_expenses = pmap_dfr(
  school_eins,
  get_school_expenses
)

# filter for just total expenses
nwc_expenses = nwc_expenses %>%
  arrange(desc(tax_prd), school) %>%
  filter(formtype == 0) %>%
  select(school, tax_prd_yr, total_expenses)


# standardize school names
nwc_expenses = nwc_expenses %>%
  mutate(
    school = case_when(
      grepl("Whitman College", school, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
        "Whitman College",
      grepl("Willamette University", school, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
        "Willamette University",
      grepl("George Fox", school, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
        "George Fox University",
      grepl("Lewis & Clark", school, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
        "Lewis & Clark College",
      grepl("Linfield", school, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
        "Linfield University",
      grepl("Pacific Lutheran", school, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
        "Pacific Lutheran University",
      grepl("Pacific University", school, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
        "Pacific University",
      grepl("Puget Sound", school, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
        "University of Puget Sound",
      grepl("Whitworth", school, ignore.case = TRUE) ~
        "Whitworth University",
      TRUE ~ school
    )
  )


# additional years for each school not on Prorepublica API call
wm = tibble(
  year = c(2025, 2024),
  exp = c(181884409, 170171725)
)

ww = tibble(
  year = c(2025, 2024),
  exp = c(150881223, 147365414)
)

wil = tibble(
  year = c(2025, 2024),
  exp = c(197287493, 190546447)
)

ups = tibble(
  year = c(2025, 2024),
  exp = c(175947358, 166535068)
)

lc = tibble(
  year = c(2025, 2024),
  exp = c(243920241, 235484369)
)

gfu = tibble(
  year = c(2025, 2024),
  exp = c(162804538, 149295263)
)

pac = tibble(
  year = c(2025, 2024),
  exp = c(184907618, 179553109)
)

plu = tibble(
  year = c(2025, 2024),
  exp = c(163733122, 168552957)
)

lin = tibble(
  year = c(2025, 2024),
  exp = c(114718470, 109617269)
)


# bind all the manually typed expenses into one ds
manual_expenses = bind_rows(
  wm  %>% mutate(school = "Willamette University"),
  ww  %>% mutate(school = "Whitworth University"),
  wil %>% mutate(school = "Whitman College"),
  ups %>% mutate(school = "University of Puget Sound"),
  lc  %>% mutate(school = "Lewis & Clark College"),
  gfu %>% mutate(school = "George Fox University"),
  pac %>% mutate(school = "Pacific University"),
  plu %>% mutate(school = "Pacific Lutheran University"),
  lin %>% mutate(school = "Linfield University")
) %>%
  select(school, tax_prd_yr = year, total_expenses = exp)

# attach manual expenses to API expenses
nwc_bigger = bind_rows(
  nwc_expenses %>%
    anti_join(
      manual_expenses,
      by = c("school", "tax_prd_yr")
    ) %>%
    select(school, tax_prd_yr, total_expenses),
  manual_expenses
) %>%
  arrange(school, tax_prd_yr)

# grab nwc schools from instLevel EADA data
d3_nwc = d3_instLevel %>%
  filter(institution_name %in% nwc_schools) %>%
  left_join(
    nwc_bigger,
    by = c(
      "institution_name" = "school",
      "year" = "tax_prd_yr"
    )
  )

# wu edited tax years in 2021 so there are two entries, need to combine them
wu_2021 = d3_nwc %>%
  filter(institution_name == "Willamette University", year == 2021) %>%
  summarize(exp = sum(total_expenses)) %>%
  pull(exp)

# put the correct expense amount for wu 2021 in
nwc_instLevel_exp = d3_nwc %>%
  filter(total_expenses != 6252286) %>%
  mutate(
    whole_total_exp = case_when(
      (institution_name == "Willamette University") & (year == 2021) ~ wu_2021, # should be 141617351
      .default = total_expenses
    ),
    perc_exp = GRND_TOTAL_EXPENSE/total_expenses
  ) %>%
  select(-total_expenses) %>%
  arrange(year, institution_name)

nwc_instLevel_exp
```

## Add winning percentage data for inst-level

```{r}
win_pct_ds = read_csv("../raw_data/win_pct.csv")

# make years, sports names, inst match original ds and fix typos
win_pct_clean = win_pct_ds %>%
  mutate(
    year = as.numeric(paste0("20", substr(Year, start = 8, stop = 9))),
    sport = case_when(
      Sport == "Softball" ~ "Women's Softball",
      Sport == "Football" ~ "Men's Football",
      .default = Sport
    ),
    win_pct = `Win Pct`,
    institution_name = School
  ) %>%
  select(-Sport, -Year, -`Year Played`, -`Win Pct`, -School) %>%
  mutate(
    win_pct = case_when(
      win_pct >= 1000 ~ win_pct / 10000,
      win_pct >= 100 ~ win_pct / 1000,
      win_pct >= 10 ~ win_pct / 100,
      win_pct >= 1 ~ win_pct / 10,
      .default = win_pct
    )
  )

# summarize inst-level win percentage
instLevel_win_pct = win_pct_clean %>%
  group_by(institution_name, year) %>%
  summarize(
    all_win_pct = mean(win_pct, na.rm = T)
  )

# add win percentage data to instLevel ds
nwc_instLevel = nwc_instLevel_exp %>%
  left_join(
    instLevel_win_pct,
    by = c("year", "institution_name")
  )

nwc_instLevel

# save data to clean folder
write_csv(nwc_instLevel, "../clean_data/nwc_instLevel_ds.csv")
```
